we have determined the preliminary crystal structure of C. gladiata seed lectin.

the structural and molecular characterization of the Canavalia gladiana lectin, a protein that is a potent mitogen for human lymphocytes.
the purification and characterization of the Canavalia glaidata seed lectin.

the lectin from C. gladiata seeds is a tetrameric protein, with two subunits in an asymmetric unit, and that it belongs to the legume lectin family.
